title: Soup loop progress event
description: One line per progress event, appended to .soup-loops/progress.jsonl (default layout). The shape of a soup ship --progress jsonl event (event, done, total, and phase/side/suite/repeat when a verdict is running) plus ts, iteration_id and stage. Lines carry no model or user content. Readers ignore unknown fields.

iteration_id.description: The iteration this work belongs to; null for a job run outside an iteration.

stage.description: Open vocabulary. soup loop writes harvest, train, verdict, deploy, canary, promote, rollback; a consuming application writes data, merge, train, ship, export, deploy. Other lowercase names are accepted.

done.description: Units finished so far; null when the stage cannot count (indeterminate).

total.description: Units in the stage; null when unknown. Never a made-up 100.

message.description: Short status text for a person; no prompts, answers or user data.

error.description: A short error code on event error (soup ship writes execution_aborted).

job_id.description: The producer's own job id, to link a job log.

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.
